---
title: "Diamond Prices by Carat and Clarity"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

diamonds_df <- read_csv("archive.zip", show_col_types = FALSE)

diamonds_df |>
  filter(carat <= 3) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = carat, y = price, color = clarity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(
    title = "Better Clarity Allows Smaller Diamonds to Command High Prices",
    subtitle = "Price vs. carat weight across nearly 54,000 diamonds, grouped by clarity grade",
    x = "Carat Weight",
    y = "Price (USD)",
    color = "Clarity",
    caption = "Source: diamonds.csv (archive.zip)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2)))
```
